finding: A hand-off continuation retried after an error is sent with a new message id and a new idempotency key
evidence: crates/a2a-protocol-client/src/delegation/continuation.rs, continuation(): a new MessageId and fresh_key() on every call, and continue_handed_back() calls it once per retry, retrying on any error. A continuation whose response was lost is therefore re-sent as a different logical request. Whether a peer then runs the turn twice was not reproduced. Planned with COR-06 (one logical continuation, one key). Fixed 2026-11-26, apart from COR-06: continue_handed_back() fixes one message id and key per hand-off and sends every retry with them (a later hand-off gets new ones); delegation/continuation_tests.rs a_continuation_sent_again_is_the_same_request loses the first continuation's response and fails before the fix with a new id and key on the resend.

finding: A continuation's save can overwrite an event another replica's still-running turn folded; only a compare-and-set write would refuse the stale save
evidence: docs/compliance/spec-ledger.json, §3.5.2 (PARTIAL), the note's last paragraph: 'Still open: the task itself keeps the lost update, and the continuing turn's first fold stores a position past it again, so a subscriber starting after that fold still misses it; only a compare-and-set write would refuse the stale save.' tests/stale_write_position covers the position, not the lost update. In no package of docs/program/ on 2026-11-26.

source: external review execution packet of 2026-11-26 (N26-01, N26-04)
finding: A delegation start that failed with a bare 503, a 500, 502 or 504 returned the budget grant and settled the journal record not_started, though the agent may have made the child
evidence: crates/a2a-protocol-client/src/delegation/mod.rs, refused(): every ClientError::UnexpectedStatus counted as a refusal, contradicting D-1, which calls a bare 503 ambiguous. tests/delegation_journal/substituted_503.rs answers the client with a bare 503 after the child ran (RUNS = 1): before the fix the parent's meter read 100 (the 40 granted refunded) where 60 was due. delegation/start_tests.rs a_bare_503_keeps_the_grant_and_leaves_the_record_open and a_500_and_a_gateways_502_and_504_are_ambiguous fail the same way before. Fixed: a 4xx, a 503 with Retry-After, an A2A error, AuthRequired or InvalidEndpoint is a refusal; any other 5xx is ambiguous. Mutation gate on the client diff: 9 mutants, 8 caught, 1 unviable, none missed.

source: external review execution packet of 2026-11-26 (N26-01, N26-04)
finding: The journal write that settles a refused start not_started had no bound, so a journal that stopped answering held Delegation::start_with for ever
evidence: crates/a2a-protocol-client/src/delegation/options.rs, start_with: journal.settle(id, "not_started", ..).await with no timeout, where begin and every later write are bounded by journal::WRITE_BOUND (5 s). delegation/start_tests.rs a_settle_that_never_answers_is_given_up_at_the_bound fails before the fix at its one-hour guard (paused clock) and passes after at exactly WRITE_BOUND, returning the refusal with the record left open. Fixed by journal::settle_not_started.

finding: A hand-off continuation refused by a halted server was sent again, up to the hand-off policy's limit
evidence: crates/a2a-protocol-client/src/delegation/continuation.rs, continue_handed_back(): every send error was logged and the loop went on, so a halt (final since COR-05, ClientError::is_halted) was answered with up to HandOffPolicy::continuations more requests. delegation/continuation_tests.rs a_halted_continuation_is_not_sent_again fails before the fix with 4 sends where 2 are due (policy of 3) and passes after; the outcome is Lost with no resume, not a made-up terminal state. A lost response (a transport error) is still sent again as the same request (a_continuation_sent_again_is_the_same_request).

source: COR-08 (E03 R8), out of scope there, recorded 2026-11-26
finding: A root halt does not stop a task of its job parked at input-required or auth-required: the parked child stays parked, and only a send that would continue it is refused
evidence: crates/a2a-protocol-server/src/handler/halt.rs, module documentation: 'A task parked at input-required or auth-required is not running and is not cancelled'. A halt fires the tokens of running turns only, so a parked task of the halted root keeps its state until a caller cancels it, its lease lapses (COR-08: the claim reaper then cancels it), or ADR 0056's expiry deletes it. Not reproduced by a test.
